answer: Here is one mechanism that works: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because pearl only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, crystal is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any opal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
